## MF64 CFW v1.0.0

### Major Features

- 4-way parallel LED output
- 0° / 90° / 180° / 270° rotation support
- Persistent rotation settings
- Rotation-aware Settings and Bootloader enter buttons
- Dual MIDI ports
- MIDI CH1–CH4 palette support
- Custom CH4 palette with storage
- Web configuration support
- Web firmware updater support
- 8-step LED brightness control
- Global LED power limiter
- Custom boot animation
- Apollo SysEx compatibility
- On-device Settings UI
